parameters.name: Condition
parameters.description: The filter conditions. Set this parameter to a JSON string in the format of {"field":"Name", "pattern":"configmap-"}.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 0.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The value 0 indicates that all entries are returned on one page.

parameters.name: ShowRelatedApps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return a list of applications that use a Secret.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas list-k8s-secrets --cluster-id 7a953f9a-2946-4c7a-9d82-9939db000000 --namespace default --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-no 0 --page-size 10 --condition field_:_Name_,_pattern_:_product --show-related-apps true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas GET /pop/v5/k8s/acs/k8s_secret --region cn-hangzhou --Condition 'field_:_Name_,_pattern_:_product' --PageSize 10 --ClusterId '7a953f9a-2946-4c7a-9d82-9939db000000' --ShowRelatedApps true --PageNo 0 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace default --header "Content-Type=application/json"
